readerCopy.body: A small change can reveal that an old protective pattern no longer has to be permanent. When Uranus trines Chiron, change and sensitivity reinforce each other, making experimentation useful where habit was organized around avoiding another bad experience. A different route, schedule, tool, or response can create new evidence without requiring the whole system to be destroyed. Freedom grows where protection is updated to match the present instead of the past.
